displayName: Don't show the option to transform a document to a Sway web page (User)
description:
This policy setting controls whether the File menu option to transform a Word document to a Sway web page is shown to the user. By default, this option is shown to the user.

If you enable this policy setting, the File menu option to transform a Word document to a Sway web page is hidden from the user. 

If you disable or don't configure this policy setting, the File menu option to transform a Word document to a Sway web page is shown to the user.

Note: This policy setting only applies to subscription versions of Office, such as Office 365 ProPlus.
